describe: Per-chunk visibility graph: BFS flood-fill over a 16^3 opaque bitset to determine which of the 6 chunk faces can see through to which others. Output = the 6x6 SetVisibility bitset packed into a long. PURE: opaque cells given as a 4096-bit input; Guava/IntegerCache/EnumFacing/BlockPos deps reduced to stdlib equivalents with identical behavior.
